capture_lineage: The final index includes settled delivered surfaces, final return/edit rechecks, dedicated early-stop captures, rebuilt production failure/retry, and the seven stable delivered views that the primary actually opened. It excludes the visibly transitional dark disclosure and earlier broad-run failures from final-product captures; all remain in the complete original archive. Earlier failure/retry frames precede the text-reveal settlement fix and are not used for final completion-text claims.
all_original_evidence: All application/instruction source, reports, screenshots, actual image returns and unaffected evidence remain original bytes in the public reconstruction. 314 session-bearing network files have explicit public projections and separately retained private originals. The linked projection manifest and complete-originals reconstruction audit identify exact original/public hashes and the private ZIP digest; the full original workspace is recoverable without inventing missing evidence.
